[2] Pressure Seraphine with W-Q Combo Seraphine lacks mobility, making her vulnerable to a W-Q combo. Exploit Seraphine's long ability cooldowns by aggressively engaging to set up a kill or force out summoner spells.

[2] Nullify Seraphine's CC with Ultimate Seraphine's E and R are powerful crowd control abilities, but Alistar's ultimate (R) instantly removes all disabling effects. Use your ultimate immediately upon being hit by Seraphine's CC to nullify it and launch a counterattack.

[2] Alistar's counter. Better range. Counterplay: Antiheal. you cant really shut down healbot as she will have impact anyways with one R in fight. Play aggressive and punish. Dont eat her R as it goes longer so it can stun teammates behind you.
[2] Keep an eye on how many empowered stacks she has. If she has 3, play safer as her next ability will be much stronger.
[2] Whenever she uses her Surround Sound(W), she will be vulnerable to an all-in. It has a really long cooldown, so try to abuse it if possible.
